notes.title: Update 2.0.1 Arrives!
notes.content:
The wait is over, Patch 2.0.1 has landed!

[h1]Explore Mode[/h1]
A new game mode has been added in ALL Kingdoms. It is accessible once that Kingdom’s quest line is finished.
Explore Mode throws you into a random battle from its Kingdom, with a few troops changed around to keep it fresh, and in return offers you a double chance of Runic Traitstones, and a triple chance at Arcane & Celestial Traitstones.
As a bonus feature, the Explore Menu shows the traitstones available in each Kingdom too!

[h1]Dual Troop Types[/h1]
Up until now, the poor Undead Dragon had to decide if he was Undead, or Dragon. So we asked ourselves… ¿Por qué no los dos? And now he gets to be both (and he feels whole again).
Apart from relieving stress on the Legion of Undead Dragons out there, this addition is sure to mix up a few team comps as new combinations of troops have access to new bonuses.
Not all troops have a double troop type, but you’ll find a goodly number of them that do!

[h1]Troop Type Changes[/h1]
In order to make Double Troop Types work, and to keep things balanced as we continue to pour lots of new troops into the game, we’ve had to add some extra troop types!
Unfortunately, that means the demise of the Marauder as a type; its members (along with many of the Wildfolk) have run off to join the new factions.

To summarize, here are the changes:
* We’ve added: Mechs, Raksha, Wargare, Centaur, Tauros, Orc, Goblin, Naga, Rogue, Mystic, Stryx, Merfolk
* We’ve removed: Marauder
* Marauders & most Wildfolk have migrated to the types above
* A few Wildfolk have stubbornly remained Wildfolk, and have been joined by a few Marauders who didn’t fit anywhere else.


[h1]Status Effects[/h1]
We have 2 new status effects, and a couple of significant changes:
* WEB: Much like Entangle with Attack, Web reduces a target’s Magic skill to 0
* STUN: A stunned troop no longer gain benefits from any of its traits
* DEATH MARK: We have removed the 2 turn grace period at the start of this effect – now it actually feels dangerous!
* ENTANGLE: This is no longer removed by Attack buffs, in fact it now stops any Attack buffs applying while in effect. Web works similarly with Magic Buffs.


[h1]Trait Changes[/h1]
We have added new Slayer and Bond traits for the new Troop types.
We have added new traits for the 2 new status effects.
* Snare: Inflict Web when doing Skull damage
* Slippery: Immunity to Web
* Stalker: Deal double Skull damage vs. Webbed enemies.
* Knockout: Inflict Stun when doing Skull damage
* Thick Head: Immunity to Stun
* Clobber: Deal double Skull damage vs. Stunned enemies.
We have added 2 new immunities:
* Indigestible: Immunity to Devour
* Mana Shield: Immunity to Mana Burn
We have modified Impervious to include the new immunities.


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
Conditional effect based on number of gems on the board increased required Gems from 10 to 13, as 10 was too easy to achieve, and 13 would still be achieved in 80% of those cases.


[h1]Troop + Weapon Balance[/h1]
[b]Atlanta[/b]
* Trait Change: Wildfolk Slayer to Centaur Slayer

[b]Blast Cannon[/b]
* Trait Change: Construct Slayer to Mech Slayer

[b]Brian the Lucky[/b]
* Trait Change: Marauder Slayer to Goblin Slayer

[b]Bul’Tauros[/b]
* Spell Change:  Increase boost ratio from 2:1 to x1

[b]Deep Borer[/b]
* Trait Change: Construct Bond to Mech Bond

[b]Dryad[/b]
* Trait Change: Impervious to Nature Link

[b]Fenrir[/b]
* Trait Change: Wildfolk Bond to Beast Bond

[b]Ghiralee[/b]
* Trait Change: Construct Bond to Mech Bond
* Trait Change: Construct Slayer to Mech Slayer

[b]Gob-Chomper[/b]
* Trait Change: Marauder Slayer to Goblin Slayer
* Spell Change: Changed chance to Devour Marauders to Goblins.

[b]Goblin Shaman[/b]
* Trait Change: Marauder Bond to Goblin Bond

[b]Golem[/b]
* Trait Change: Impervious to Stone Link

[b]Herdmaster[/b]
* Trait Change: Wildfolk Bond to Centaur Bond
* Trait Change: Impervious to Air Link

[b]Naga Queen[/b]
* Trait Change: Marauder Bond to Naga Bond

[b]Pride Hunter[/b]
* Trait Change: Wildfolk Bond to Raksha Bond

[b]Ragnagord[/b]
* Trait Change: Marauder Bond to Wildfolk Bond

[b]Ranger[/b]
* Trait Change: Wildfolk Bond to Wargare Bond

[b]Raven[/b]
* Trait Change: Marauder Slayer to Naga Slayer

[b]Sparkgrinder[/b]
* Trait Change: Construct Bond to Mech Bond
* Spell Change: Spell bonus now applies to Mechs instead of Contructs

[b]Steam Turret[/b]
* Trait Change: Construct Bond to Mech Bond

[b]Swamplash[/b]
* Trait Change: Impervious to Huge

[b]Tau[/b]
* Trait Change: Impervious to Empowered

[b]Wild Fang[/b]
* Trait Change: Wildfolk Slayer to Centaur Slayer
* Spell Change: Spell bonus damage now applies to Centaurs instead of Wildfolk

[b]Goblin Smasher[/b]
* Spell Change: Changed bonus damage vs Marauders to vs Goblins.


[h1]Zhul'Kari Balance Changes[/h1]
[b]Reaver[/b]
* Spell Change: Spell no longer removes red gems to boost damage.
* Spell now deals extra damage if the enemies are webbed 9applies individually to each troop)
* Base spell damage increase from 0 to 1

[b]Dark Maiden[/b]
* Trait Change: Fire Spirit changed to Snare
* Spell Rework: Spell now Transforms all Yellow Gems to a chosen color. Giving first Ally Life, boosted by gems transformed.
* Spell‘s name has changed
* Mana cost increased from 6 to 10
* No longer gains Magic at levels 4, 16, 17, 19

[b]Night Terror[/b]
* Spell no longer removes Blue Gems to boost damage. Spell now deals damage to weakest enemy and steals 1 Magic.
* Base Spell damage increased from 0 to 1.
* Mana Color Change: Change from Red/ Purple to Red/ Brown

[b]Spider Queen[/b]
* Spell now also Webs target.

[b]Webspinner[/b]
* Trait Changes: Changed Daemon Bond to Sturdy
* Trait Changes: Changed 2nd Trait with Snare

[b]Dokkalfar[/b]
* Trait Change: Change Alert to Slippery

[b]Spider Swarm[/b]
* Spell Rework: Spider Swarm has gain the old Dark Maiden’s spell, which will deal damage and poison an enemy.
* Trait Change: Change Cunning to Slippery


[h1]Troop Refunds[/h1]
The following troops are available for Refunds:
* Aziris 
* Dark Maiden 
* Dire Wolf 
* Dokkalfar 
* Dryad
* Golem
* Herdmaster
* Marid 
* Night Terror 
* Queen Mab 
* Swamplash
* Tau
* Thrall 
* Webspinner 
* Winter Wolf 


[h1]Other[/h1]
Facebook support has been removed as it was causing game crashes. It will be replaced when bugs are fixed.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
* Fixed Chat issues that were causing the game to slow down and feel laggy.
* Fixed issue with Famine’s 3rd trait that would cause the game to freeze when it killed the last troop.
* Fixed issue with Frenzy where spell with randomly split damage (like Rowanne’s Thorns) would cause it to trigger multiple times.
* Fixed issue where player would not have weapons in Arena
* Fixed issue where Shop text would appear behind the World Map after redeeming a code.
* Fixed issue where some Defense Wins were not rewarding PVP points correctly
* Fixed issue where viewing a player in Arena could cause the game to stop allowing spells to be cast.
* Fixed an issue where creating or modifying teams would not be saved if playing between 2 devices.
* Fixed Guild Weekly Stats not resetting correctly.
* Fixed issue where Serve and Protect wasn’t always giving Barrier to the correct troops.
* Fixed issue where Dust and Sand wasn’t always debuffing all enemies.
* Fixed issue where collecting PVP Defense rewards would take the player to the Tier Reward screen afterwards.
* Fixed an issue where Guild weekly stats are not resetting properly or would reset in the middle of the week.
* Fixed a display issue where it looked like the player would receive less gold than intended for a 4 Star kingdom.
* Fixed PVP Battle Log display issues.
* Fixeed issue where PVP Tier was not resetting correctly.


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
* Gem Mastery bonus from Hero Classes is not included/ displayed on the Gem Mastery Overview screen in the Hero menu.
* AI troops with Blessed and Curse are not activating correctly.
* Marid’s Spell applying random status effect even when there isn’t correct number of gems on the board.
* Black Beast’s spell will not create skulls if he doesn’t devour anyone.
* Rare issue where using a Dust Devil’s spell may cause a Ghost troop (unkillable troop).


Please note this Update only applies to Steam, iOS and Android versions of the game.

notes.title: 2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi All,

The wait is over, Patch 2.0 arrives! Get all the details on what's new and what's changed below!

[h1]PVP Rework[/h1]
* The PVP Menu now has 6 new menus, Ranked, Casual, Stats, Defense, Battle Log and Leaderboard. 

[b]Ranked:[/b] 
* Allows you choose between 3 opponents to earn points for rankings in the weekly event.
* Ranked is played at normal difficulty with the Combo-breaker turned off.
* The old Rank system is still around as the new Tier system (we've just renamed it, since "Rank" now applies to your position on the PvP Ladder). 
* Tier Rewards can be collected once when you’ve reached a new tier level. 
* Rank Rewards given at the end of an event are based on what rank you were when the event ended. 

[b]Casual:[/b] 
* Allows you choose between 3 opponents for a fun battle that does not affect PvP points or ranking.
* Casual is played at your currently-selected difficulty.
* Casual battles have a slightly reduced reward compared to Ranked battles.

[b]Stats:[/b]
* Shows various stats for your PvP Career including: 
* Current Tier and rewards for each Tier.
* Current Rank and rewards for with week’s event.
* Current Wins and Losses for Invades and Defenses.
* Favorite Troop for invading.
* Most Invaded Kingdom.

[b]Defense:[/b]
* The Defense menu works the same as before, but now displays the current progress for successful defense rewards. 

[b]Battle Log:[/b]
* The Battle Log displays all of your recent battles (invades and defenses), whether you won or lost, and how long ago the battle was. 

[b]Leaderboards:[/b]
* Leaderboards show both your current rank as well as the top 100 players in the current weekly event. 

[h1]Summoning Improvements[/h1]
* Summoning is no longer limited to a cap of level 15 for troops. 
* Summoned troops are now limited by what level you have raised that troop to. 
* Summoned troops now gain any team bonuses earned at the start of battle (from Troop type or Kingdom bonuses). 
* Summoned troops come in with any trait you have unlocked on the troop. 
* Summoning changes do not apply to Arena. 

[h1]Hero Profiles[/h1]
* We’ve added a new social feature to the game: Hero Profiles. 
* Hero Profiles allow you to view various information about another player in the game. 
* You are able to use the Hero Profile to invite players to your guild or play in a friendly battle. 
* Friendly battles do not give out rewards. 
* You can access the new Hero Profile menu by tapping on a player’s name in chat or viewing it in the PVP Menus (either from the Leaderboard or Battle Log menus). 

[h1]New Kingdom[/h1]
* Glacial Peaks has appeared on the map to unlock. 
* New troops (including 2 new legendary troops) have been added to chests. 
* Glacial Peaks introduces a new spell mechanic: Mana Burn 
~ Mana Burn deals damage to an enemy based on the enemy’s current mana.
~ Mana Burn does not drain Mana from the enemy.

[h1]VIP Chests[/h1]
* VIP Chests have had some improvements: 
~ If you draw an epic card, you will gain 2 copies of that reward.
~ If you draw a traitstone you gain 2 copies of that traitstone.
~ VIP Chests now also rewards 2000 gold for every chest you open.

[h1]Mythic Troops[/h1]
* Mythic troops are super rare troops that can drop from Glory, Gem, and VIP chests. 
* Mythic troops are the only troops with triple Mana colors. 
* Like Legendaries they have a unique 3rd Trait. 
* New Mythic Troop- War- has been added to chests. 

[h1]Treasure Hunt[/h1]
* Red Chests no longer reward Gold 
* Vaults no longer reward Gold and Souls 

[h1]General[/h1]
* Claim All button has been added to the Mail menu, allows you to claim all rewards from mail at once. 
* Victory and Defeat Menus has had a visual rework, and now display rewards from battles similar to Treasure Hunt mini game. 
* Increased security to reduce amount of hacking with the new PvP changes. 
* Mechanist Class’ legendary trait, Clockwork, has been added to the class. 
* You can now opt out of Global Chat but still be part of Guild Chat. 

[h1]Troop Balance[/h1]
[b]Infernal King[/b] 
* Immortal trait chance has been reduced from 30% to 25%

[b]Banshee[/b]
* Mana cost has been reduced from 14 to 12

[h1]Troop Refunds[/h1]
* Infernal King is available for refund for 1 week. 

[h1]Major Bug Fixes[/h1]
* Game no longer crashes when casting Soothsayer’s spell when there are no purple gems on the board. 
* Frenzy should no longer activate multiple times from damage. 
* Game should no longer end when a Troop is summoned from final troop’s Trait (such as Daemonic Pact). 
* On Hit Traits (Such a Great Maw’s Hunger) should not trigger on multiple troops with large skull cascades. 
* Hero Class Troop types should now be working correctly. Hero should now gain benefits/weaknesses from troop type spells/ bonuses. 
* Watcher’s Mana drain on status effect now applies to Frozen, Disease and Death Mark. 
* AOE Damage will now pop Barrier. 
* We believe we have addressed the main cause of Dust Devil crashing after casting his spell. 
* Fixed Mist Stalker’s spell so he should be dealing poison as intended. 
* Hero Class Magic bonuses should no longer apply in the Arena. 

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
* Gem Mastery bonus from Hero Classes is not included/ displayed on the Gem Mastery Overview screen in the Hero menu. 
* AI troops with Blessed and Curse are not activating correctly.

Game should no longer end when a Troop is summoned from final troop’s Trait (such as Daemonic Pact).
On Hit Traits (Such a Great Maw’s Hunger) should not trigger on multiple troops with large skull cascades.
Hero Class Troop types should now be working correctly. Hero should now gain benefits/weaknesses from troop type spells/ bonuses.
Watcher’s Mana drain on status effect now applies to Frozen, Disease and Death Mark.
AOE Damage will now pop Barrier.
We believe we have addressed the main cause of Dust Devil crashing after casting his spell.
Fixed Mist Stalker’s spell so he should be dealing poison as intended.
Hero Class Magic bonuses should no longer apply in the Arena.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 Arrives!
notes.content:
[h1]Hero Classes[/h1]
•	Players will be able to unlock classes for their Heroes by completing Class Quests.
•	Class Quests appear after you have finished the main story in a Kingdom

•	There are 7 Classes when 1.0.9 launches, with more to come in the future
o	Warlord- Quest located in Broken Spire
o	Knight- Quest located in Sword’s Edge
o	Priest- Quest located in Whitehelm
o	Archer- Quest located in Forest of Thorns
o	Warden- Quest located in Maugrim Woods
o	Sorcerer- Quest located in Karakoth
o	Necromancer - Quest located in Khetar

•	Classes can be levelled using Souls, each level grants extra Spell Mastery for a single color, and occasionally grants extra Magic when using weapons of a certain color.
•	Classes like troops, have 20 levels, each one giving extra Skills
•	Classes have 3 Traits, like troops, that must be unlocked. The 3rd trait is always a unique and powerful Legendary Trait.
•	Classes have 3 perks, obtained after 10, 25, and 50 victories.  Perks grant extra skill points, or allow the Hero to function as a Troop Types
•	At Level 10, all classes give the Hero a Kingdom Type, just like troops get (always the Kingdom that they are unlocked in).
•	At 250 Victories, Classes unlock a special Mythical Class Weapon with a powerful spell.

[h1]New Kingdoms[/h1]
The Kingdoms of Drifting Sands and Blighted Lands have appeared in the game. You can find their kingdom troops in chests!
[i]Please note that Ifrit and Venbarak are not currently available in chests. They are coming in future events.[/i]

[h1]World Map Layout[/h1]
•	The world map has had a makeover with a new look.
•	Glory is now displayed as a currency like Gold and Gems.

•	Chat- a new chat system has been added to the game. 
o	There are 2 Tabs for Chat- Global and Guild
o	Global Chat- allows Players to chat together in game from any screen.
o	Guild Chat has been moved from the guild menu to be part of the new chat system.
o	There is Leave button on the chat screen for players who aren't feeling chatty today.

[h1]Balance[/h1]
•	Challenge battles have been reworked so that they are more interesting and challenging to play.

•	Troops now gain uniquely-tailored Skill points for levels 16-20 and as well as ascending, this means that the Skill values on troops will have changed from patch 1.0.8.
o	All troops have been affected by this so we haven’t listed out the exact changes here. See the updated Troop List.

•	Traits
o	All (natural) Legendary Troops have gain special unique Legendary Traits
o	True Shot has been changed to have a 75% chance to activate and has become a Legendary Trait (on Orion).
o	Added new Trait: Armor Piercing, which has a 50% chance to ignore Armor on Skull matches. This has replace True-Shot on most Troops.
o	Agile has been changed to have 20% chance to activate (down from 30%).
o	Blessed and Cursed effects have increased from 1 to 2
o	Leader’s effect has been increased from 2 to 3

•	New Traits have been added to the game.
o	Chill Touch- Frozen on Skull damage
o	Shatter- Double damage vs Frozen Enemies
o	Insulated- Immunity to Frozen
o	Death Touch- Death Mark on Skull damage
o	Doom- Double damage vs Death Marked Enemies
o	Warded- Immunity to Death Mark
o	Grudge- Gain 1 Attack when an enemy casts a spell

•	Status Effects
o	Burning and Poison can now kill a troop.
o	Silence no longer drains Mana from victims
o	New Status Effect: Frozen, a Frozen troop cannot contribute extra turns to its team, either from its spell, or from matching 4/5-of-a-kind of its color. (Note that it CAN still contribute turns as indirect result of gems spawned by its spell forming a 4/5-of-a-kind, provided they do not match one of its own colors).
o	New Status Effect: Death Mark, Troops with Death mark have a 10% chance to immediately die at the start of their turn. This cannot occur in the first 2 turns after they receive death mark.
o	New Status Effect: Barrier, A troop with Barrier is immune to the next piece of damage he receives, either from skulls, spells, or status effects.
o	New Status Effect: Disease, a Diseased troop only gains half the mana from gem matches (round up).

•	Kingdom Stat changes
o	Zhul’Kari has changed from Attack to Magic
o	Mist of Scales has changed from Life to Armor
o	Grosh-Nak has changed from Attack to Armor

•	Team Bonus Changes
o	Zaejin Team Bonus has changed from +10 Life for 4 troops to +4 Life and +3 Attack
o	Stormheim Team Bonus has changed from +2 Life and +4 Attack for 4 troops to +10 Life for 4 troops 
o	Maugrim Woods Team Bonus has changed from +4 Life and + 3 Attack for 4 troops to +2 Life and +4 Attack

[h1]Troop Balance[/h1]
Each (native) Legendary gain Legendary Traits the replaced existing traits. Legendary Traits are always the third trait unlock, despite where the remove Trait was. In addition, many non-Legendary Troops were rebalanced. For a full list, please visit: gemsofwar.com

[h1]Refunds Available[/h1]
Due to the balancing adjustments, the following Troops will be available for Refund for one week:
•	Atlanta
•	Avina
•	Bone Dragon
•	Celestasia
•	Centaur Scout
•	Cthyryzyx
•	Frost Giant
•	Ghoul
•	Glade Warden
•	Gnoll
•	Lady Sapphira
•	Orc
•	Orion
•	Ranger
•	Reaver
•	Skeleton
•	Wolf Knight

[h1]General[/h1]
•	Ascension- the Arrow buttons will now cause more cards to be deducted than 1. This should save many fingers from Ascensions requiring 25+ troops.

•	Refund Menu- Players are able to refund a troop, gaining back souls and Traitstones spent on it.
o	Refund will only be offered at the discretion of the dev team, when they believe a troop has been nerfed
o	Troop Refunds will only be offered for a single week
o	Refund Button is found when you tap on a Card in the Troop Collection Menu.

•	Difficulty- Has moved to the World Map from Hero menu
o	No longer affects PVP or Arena
o	Both PVP and Arena will gradually increase the difficulty (slightly) as you progress, gradually turning off the AI Combo-breaker (as you approach 8 wins in the Arena, and as you approach Rank 1 in PvP). This means that games will start getting harder the better you are doing.
o	Difficulties will now unlock as you level up.

•	Arena
o	Soul have increased back to 1.0.7 levels!
o	You now have to win 7 matches in order to be able to purchase the troops
o	The purchase price for troops you already own has been increased from 1 Gem, to be in-line with what you would pay for a key.

•	Treasure Hunt Mini Game has received a little love
o	Turns reduced to 8 (from 15).  This reduces the total number of moves in a game by 10-20% (NOT by 50%)
o	Most payouts in treasure hunt have been increased by around 20%
o	Every 15 moves will give you a random Traitstone
o	New result summary with number of turns played & score
o	New payout table has been added to the right hand side of the board

[h1]Major Bug Fixes[/h1]
•	Fixed an issue where a Troop with agile wouldn’t die despite taking damage.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
•	When the Black Beast has no longer has an Ally to devour, he doesn’t create Skull Gems (as per his the latest changes to his spell).
•	Watcher's Mana drain does not trigger on the new status effects: Death Mark, Frozen and Disease.

notes.title: Gem Sale & New Quests
notes.content:
Lots of stuff happening in Gems of War this weekend (May 15-18)

1. GEM SALE
All Gem Packages give 50% bonus Gems in the store this weekend

If you purchase a pack of 7 or more Magic Keys from the in-game shop this weekend, you get a bonus dual-color weapon, Sun & Moon, that not only damages your enemies, but buffs your team's Magic

There is no six, I just like the number 6.  It's my favorite number (unless there's 3 of them)

You can read more about the event on our website at:
http://gemsofwar.com/new-event-vault-breaker/

notes.title: New Event: Gathering Storm
notes.content:
Stormheim is here! The clouds have parted to reveal our first new kingdom.

And to celebrate that, we’ve got a new event AND a whole bunch of minor tweaks to troop balance.

[b]KINGDOM: Stormheim[/b]

The Giants have arrived. If you’re level 25 or higher, you can unlock this kingdom in the far north east of Krystara.

Meet Keghammer the Dwarf, and find out why the Giants are all at war, try out some new challenges, or turn in those keys you’ve been saving to see if you can get the 6 new troops of Stormheim.

[i]NOTE: There is a minor glitch in some iOS versions of the game which fails to show the Stormheim Shield on Stormheim Troop Cards. This is fixed in 1.0.5.[/i]

[b]EVENT: Gathering Storm[/b]

We’re off to Stormheim. As well as the 6 troops you can get in game from Keys, we have a seventh Stormheim troop only available with Glory! Earn Glory every day you log in, based on your PvP/Invasion Ranking! This event will run for 2 weeks (until Monday 16th February 2015).
[list]
[*]Frost Reaver (60 Glory): A new epic weapon, straight from the icy-cold forges of the Frost Giants. Destroy columns of Gems, and deal bonus damage for each Blue Gem destroyed!
[*]Ice Witch (120 Glory): A new epic troop – one of the spirits of the fjords. She can be a powerful ally, not necessarily destroying your enemies, but instead increasing your own Magic skills!
[/list]

[b]BALANCE: Troop Tweaks[/b]
We have a whole heap of troops getting their balance tweaked in minor ways in preparation for 1.0.5, and we’ve set them loose upon you a little early!

Lots of Common, Rare and Ultra Rare troops have received some changes, mostly buffs, to help with our Arena Mode in 1.0.5 (but more on that later). There’s also a ncie tweak to Orion, with a further update to that coming in the actual 1.0.5 update.

You can find the change list [url=http://gemsofwar.com/1-0-5-balance-changes/]here[/url].

[i]NOTE: Any troops/weapons listed as doing random amounts of damage (e.g. 3-8 points), require an update to the game. They will continue to do a minimum of 1 point (e.g. 1-8 points) until 1.0.5 actually releases.[/i]

[b]PvP Reset & Soul Rewards[/b]
Don’t forget, your PvP ranking is reset back to 15 today, and you are given some Souls. The number of Souls depends on your PvP Rank, and is listed below
[list]
[*]Rank 1: 200 Souls
[*]Rank 2: 100 Souls
[*]Rank 3: 80 Souls
[*]Rank 4: 60 Souls
[*]Rank 5: 50 Souls
[*]Rank 6: 40 Souls
[*]Rank 7: 35 Souls
[*]Rank 8: 30 Souls
[*]Rank 9: 25 Souls
[*]Rank 10: 20 Souls
[*]Rank 11: 16 Souls
[*]Rank 12: 12 Souls
[*]Rank 13: 8 Souls
[*]Rank 14: 4 Souls
[*]Rank 15: No Souls for You!
[/list]
We may tinker with these rewards in future, just keep in mind we have a bunch more ways of getting souls coming – one of them today… the Valkyrie! AND please note these souls are NOT boosted by Armor (the same as all Daily Reward Gold is not boosted by Armor). Only rewards that are an immediate result of a battle gain the Armor boosts.

[*]Ice Witch (120 Glory): A new epic troop – one of the spirits of the fjords. She can be a powerful ally, not necessarily destroying your enemies, but instead increasing your own Magic skills!

For just 110 Glory, you can use Xathenos’ hand to wither, poke, tickle, slap, and digitally harass your foes as much as your evil heart desires. notes.title: Holiday Gem Sale + Game Update!
notes.content:
Our holiday-themed event has just started. You can read more details here:
http://gemsofwar.com/holiday-event-sale-wreck-the-halls/

You can earn a new troop, Ragnagord the Reindeer, along with a new weapon for your Hero, Silent Night.

We also have a Gem Sale running for a limited time over the holidays. You can get 20%-100% bonus Gems from our in-game store.

Finally - some good news for our Steam players... this update contains some bug fixes that should help with:
[list]
 [*]Missing Daily bonuses
 [*]Guild XP Bars
 [*]System Clock issues that effect gold collection
 [*]Performance issues on the Guild Roster Menu
 [*]Plus various other miscellaneous quality-of-life fixes
[/list]
Breaking news! As some of you *may* know, we need to keep the Steam & iOS versions in sync because they share a server. 
We had given up hope on an iOS 1.0.4 version being approved before Christmas, so we had only included a single new feature for you in this Steam Build (weapon selection from the Troop-Setup menu), but we just got word that the iOS version is ready to go!

So, expect to see a few new features appear in your game over the next 24 hours, including:
[list]
 [*]Guild Chat
 [*]Extra Info on the Guild Roster menu (contributions, trophies, login time, etc)
 [*]The ability to Disenchant multiple troops at once
 [*]More outfits, that will now have a bonus to Souls/Gold/XP acquired
 [*]A DEFEND button to set your Home Kingdom's defenders, for when you are Invaded (it was a little unclear how that worked before)
 [*]Troops will be able to level up to level 15 (and higher rarity troops will cost a little more to level)
 [*]There's a news menu, that displays any news about the game
 [*]Finally, events (from Jan 5 onwards) will now cause a reset of PvP rank (but you still keep any excess glory)
[/list]
Enjoy!

 [*]There's a news menu, that displays any news about the game
 [*]Finally, events (from Jan 5 onwards) will now cause a reset of PvP rank (but you still keep any excess glory)
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: New Event: Mischief Maker
notes.content:
While we’re waiting for the 1.0.3 update, it’s time for a new event! This time, the Glory Rewards are new to the game! Read on to learn more!

Sylvasi, the Mischief Maker has been seen in Pan’s Vale. He’s yours during this event for just 120 Glory! So, unless you have some Glory saved up, you better start invading those enemies! This event will run for 2 weeks (until Monday 22nd December). We’ll be switching over to weekly events some time early in the new year.

[list]
    [*]Sylvasi (120 Glory): A new epic troop from Pan’s Value with new spell, Mischief, that converts gems and steals Attack.
    [*]Sylvasi’s Blades (60 Glory): A new epic weapon – only obtainable from this event
[/list]

More info about the event and the upcoming patch and PvP rank resets can be found at the [url=http://gemsofwar.com/new-event-mini-update-mischief-maker/]Gems of War[/url] website.
